description:
Langton's self-reproducing loop.

Source: C. G. Langton, "Self-reproduction in cellular automata", Physica D 10
(1984) 135-144. The transitions are the paper's Table I as printed, all 219,
in its order. The paper writes each as CTRBL->I (the center, its top, right,
bottom and left neighbors, and the center's next state) and lists no
rotations; here each is the six digits C N E S W C', and the rotations are the
table's rotate4 symmetry. The paper says nothing of a neighborhood the table
doesn't list; such a cell keeps its state, as in every rule table.

The starter pattern (Langtons-Loops.rle) is the loop of the paper's Fig. 6.
At generation 151 the run holds the loop and its offspring of Fig. 9.

Re-authored for heaton-life from the paper (spec/ruletable.md).
